prompt: Build the orders page for Fernhill Market's admin: a table of today's orders with order number, customer, items, total and a status badge (paid, packing, shipped, refunded), plus a search field above the table.
notes: Table with five columns; each status is a Badge variant (success, warning, info, destructive) with a text label, never color alone; the search field is an Input with a visible label. No hard-coded colors.

prompt: Create the 'Add product' form for Fernhill Market: name, price, category (Produce, Bakery, Dairy, Pantry), stock quantity and a short description, with Save product and Cancel buttons.
notes: Form inside a Card; category is a Select; every field has a label; primary Button 'Save product' and an outline 'Cancel'. Errors appear under the field in the destructive color.

prompt: Design the Fernhill Market sales dashboard: four summary cards (revenue today, orders, average basket, returns), a tab switch between Today, This week and This month, and a table of the top 5 products.
notes: Four Cards with the number as the main element; Tabs change the period; the top-products Table follows. Trends are Badges with an arrow and text, not color alone. Numbers are marked as example data.

prompt: Show the Fernhill Market orders page when the store has no orders yet: explain why the list is empty and offer a button to share the store link.
notes: Empty state inside a Card: a title that says what is missing, one sentence on what to do, one primary Button 'Copy store link'. No illustration, no table header with zero rows.

prompt: Build the Fernhill Market checkout step that shows a declined card: keep the order summary, show what went wrong and let the shopper try another card.
notes: Destructive Alert at the top that says what happened and what to do next; the order summary Card stays; card fields are Inputs; primary Button 'Pay with another card'. The error is not only red: it has an icon and text.

prompt: Add a confirmation before deleting a product in Fernhill Market's catalog: the dialog names the product and warns that its sales history stays.
notes: Dialog with a title naming the product, one sentence on the consequence, a destructive Button 'Delete product' and an outline 'Keep product'. Focus starts on the safe action and Esc closes.

prompt: Create the Fernhill Market inventory screen: a table of products with stock level, a warning for items below their reorder point, and a filter by category.
notes: Warning Alert summarizes how many items are low; low rows show a warning Badge with text; the category filter is a Select. Amber only for warning.

prompt: Design a customer profile page for Fernhill Market's support team: contact details, loyalty tier, the last 10 orders and an internal note field.
notes: Details in a Card; loyalty tier as a Badge; last orders in a Table; the note is a labeled Input with a 'Save note' Button. Customer data is fictitious.

prompt: Build the delivery slot picker for Fernhill Market's checkout: choose a day and a two-hour window, with full slots shown as unavailable.
notes: Days as Tabs; each window is a Button; full windows are disabled with a Badge 'Full' and a Tooltip with the reason. The selected slot is clear without color alone.

prompt: Add a global command menu (Cmd+K) to Fernhill Market's admin to jump to orders, products, customers and settings.
notes: Command inside a Dialog, opened with Cmd+K; results grouped by type; arrow keys move, Enter opens, Esc closes; an empty result says 'No results for …'.

prompt: On mobile, Fernhill Market's product list needs filters (category, price range, in stock only) in a panel that slides from the side.
notes: Filters inside a Sheet; category is a Select, price range is two labeled Inputs; footer with 'Show 24 products' and 'Clear filters' Buttons. Controls are 44 px tall on touch.

prompt: Create the order detail page for Fernhill Market: items with quantity and price, delivery address, payment status and buttons to refund or print the receipt.
notes: Items in a Table inside a Card; payment status as a Badge; 'Refund order' is an outline Button that opens a confirmation, 'Print receipt' is secondary. Totals align right.

prompt: Build the Fernhill Market store settings page with tabs for General, Delivery and Payments; the General tab has the store name, contact email and time zone.
notes: Tabs for the three sections; General has labeled Inputs and a Select for the time zone; 'Save changes' Button shows a Sonner toast 'Settings saved' on success.

prompt: Show the Fernhill Market orders table while the data is loading, then the loaded state.
notes: Loading state keeps the table header and shows placeholder rows with an accessible 'Loading orders' label; the refresh Button shows a spinner and 'Loading…'. Nothing jumps when the data arrives.

prompt: Design the 'Invite a supplier' flow for Fernhill Market: email, company name and the categories they supply, with a success message after sending.
notes: Form in a Dialog; labeled Inputs and a Select; primary Button 'Send invite'; after success the Dialog closes and a Sonner toast confirms with the email address.

prompt: Build the promotions page for Fernhill Market: active, scheduled and ended promotions, each with its discount, dates and status, and a button to create a new one.
notes: Tabs for the three groups; a Table per tab; status as a Badge with text; 'Create promotion' as the primary Button at the top right. Ended promotions are muted, not hidden.

prompt: After a refund in Fernhill Market's admin, show the confirmation: amount, method and when the customer will see it, with a link back to the order.
notes: Success Alert with an icon and text; a Card with the refund details; a link-style Button 'Back to order'. Green is paired with the check icon and words.

prompt: Create the Fernhill Market staff page: a table of staff members with their role (Owner, Manager, Cashier) and a way to change a role, with a tooltip explaining each role.
notes: Table of people; role changes through a Select per row; a Tooltip on the role header explains each role; the owner row has a Badge 'You' and its Select is disabled.

prompt: Show what Fernhill Market's point-of-sale screen does when the connection drops: sales keep working offline and sync later.
notes: Warning Alert at the top: 'You're offline. Sales are saved on this device and sync when you reconnect.' A Badge counts unsynced sales; a 'Try again' Button. No blocking modal.

prompt: Design a weekly report card for Fernhill Market's owner: revenue against last week, best-selling product, and a button to download the report as CSV.
notes: One Card; revenue as the main number with a Badge for the change (arrow + text); a Tooltip explains how the change is calculated; outline Button 'Download CSV'. Numbers are marked as example data.
